label: Claude PRs merged
means: Of the pull requests Claude finished, the share that merged rather than closed unused.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a closed PR is a session's work thrown away; a repo sets its own in quality/targets/claude.json
source: pr-link entries in this repo's Claude Code transcripts, joined with gh api graphql, each linked PR 50 to a query; merged out of merged plus closed, over the last params.last.prs (default 20) opened Claude PRs that have merged or closed; the funnel's last stage drops those reverted by now. Pick N so it turns over within hours at the repo's pace

label: Green on first push
means: How often every automatic check passed on the first version Claude pushed.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a red first push costs a fix round and a second CI run
source: statusCheckRollup of the last commit made before each Claude PR opened (gh api graphql, each linked PR 50 to a query, then each first-push commit's checks); green out of green plus red, over the last params.last.prs (default 20) opened Claude PRs; a cancelled check is no verdict, and the checks in params.not_code_checks are left out

params.comment: Checks that read the PR rather than run its code, such as a model review; their failures say nothing about the code, so they are left out. None by default.

label: Escaped bugs per 10 PRs
means: Bug reports filed against the latest merged pull requests, per ten of them.
goal_source: goal from DORA's change failure rate, read as bugs per merged PR: the elite band's 5% is 0.5 per 10, and the high band's 20% is the near band, 2 per 10 (2024 Accelerate State of DevOps Report, p. 13, dora.dev/research/2024/dora-report)
source: issues typed Bug, filed after the merge, whose title or body names one of the last params.last.prs (default 20) merged Claude PRs as the cause: a Regressed-by: #N line, or a phrase such as "introduced in #N" or "caused by #N" (causes() in github.mjs, as the Blockers tab reads them); a PR mentioned for context is no cause (gh issue list --label bug), per 10 of those PRs: the state of those PRs now

label: Code PRs that touch tests
means: Of merged pull requests that change code, the share that also change a test.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: most code changes should move a test; copy and config fixes need none, so the goal stays below every PR
source: of the last params.last.prs (default 20) merged Claude PRs, those that change a .astro, .js, .mjs, .ts, .tsx, .py or .sh file other than a config or test file, and the share of them that also change a test, spec, fixture, selftest or e2e file (gh api graphql, each linked PR 50 to a query: files)

label: Session start to PR open
means: How long a session works before it opens its pull request.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a task scoped to land in one sitting
source: median of PR createdAt (gh api graphql, each linked PR 50 to a query) minus the first timestamp of the session that linked it, over the last params.last.prs (default 20) opened Claude PRs; the PR opening is the event, so a session with no PR adds nothing

label: Tokens per merged PR
means: New tokens Claude read and wrote for each of the latest merged pull requests, not counting cheap cache rereads.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: the tokens billed at full or write price, about a short session's worth per PR
source: input plus output plus cache-write tokens from message.usage, one count per message.id, mean over the last params.last.consumption (default 10) merged Claude PRs; a PR's tokens are its linking session's, split evenly over the PRs that session opened and merged

label: Cache-read share of input
means: How much of what Claude reads comes from its cache, which costs far less than fresh input.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a cache read is priced at a small fraction of fresh input (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), so a cache miss reprices a whole context
source: cache_read_input_tokens out of input plus cache-write plus cache-read tokens (message.usage, one count per message.id), over the last params.last.calls (default 1,000) model calls

label: API-equivalent USD per merged PR
means: What each merged pull request would cost at API prices; on a subscription plan nothing is billed per call.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: the price check behind the token metrics
source: totalCostUSD from the last cost-state record of the session that linked each of the last params.last.consumption (default 10) merged Claude PRs, split evenly over the PRs that session opened and merged, mean over the PRs whose session has one; API-equivalent

label: Median context per model call
means: How much Claude carries into each model call; a bigger context costs more and spreads attention thinner.
goal_source: goal from the default trigger of server-side compaction in the Claude Messages API, 150K tokens, whose minimum is 50K (platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/compaction-threshold, read 2026-11-03), the point Anthropic treats a context as long enough to summarize; near band: template default
source: median of input plus cache-write plus cache-read tokens per model call (message.usage, one count per message.id), over the last params.last.calls (default 1,000) model calls

label: Compactions per 10 merged PRs
means: How often a session filled its context and had to summarize itself, against how many pull requests merged.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a compaction drops detail the session gathered
source: transcript entries with type system and subtype compact_boundary (nothing else read from them; the field is observed in transcripts, not named in Anthropic's public docs), per 10 of the last params.last.prs (default 20) merged Claude PRs; a PR's compactions are its linking session's, split evenly over the PRs that session opened and merged

label: Subagent share of cost

params.comment: Dollars per million tokens, from the source page, read 2026-11-03. long is the price over long_context_tokens of prompt (input plus cache). A model's own cache_read_x overrides the default. A model missing here is left out of both sides and counted. project_match (unset: the repo's own project folder) and last (N per kind of event) may be set on any target in this file. projects_dir: where Claude Code keeps session transcripts; a ~/ path is under home, an absolute one is itself, any other is under the repo root.

means: Of what the calls would cost on the API, the share subagents spent; a cheap model lowers it.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: at most half the spend in subagents, priced, so routing work to a cheaper model reads as cheaper
source: message.usage and message.model of this repo's transcripts, over the last params.last.calls (default 1,000) model calls, rows from Claude Code 2.1.307 on, each priced by its model
